filterRule: Artificial Analysis model pages archived in full for the 21 target configurations. Vendor pricing pages publish many tiers and regions; archived here is the tier the catalog quotes - Google Standard, Alibaba Singapore/International list price, Thinking Machines Serverless Inference - with the other tiers recorded in this note rather than as rows.
schema: Model operating parameters, NOT benchmark scores. Completes the speed, latency and vendor-price fields check:models reported as unsourced.

tiersNotArchived.google: Batch and Flex are half Standard; Priority is 1.8x. Gemini 3.1 Pro also prices >200k-token prompts separately at $4/$18.
tiersNotArchived.alibaba: China/HK/Frankfurt/Virginia/Tokyo regions are listed at roughly two thirds of the Singapore price. Qwen3.6 Plus prices >256k-token input at 4x.
tiersNotArchived.thinkingMachines: Tinker training/sampling pricing is a different product from Serverless Inference; only the latter is comparable to the other models here.
tiersNotArchived.anthropic: Claude Sonnet 5's $2/$10 is introductory through 2026-08-31, reverting to $3/$15. Fast mode is 2x; US-only inference is 1.1x.

note: This batch overturns an earlier conclusion. Batch 06 recorded that LMArena's price column was unreliable because it disagreed with the catalog on Claude Fable 5 ($10/$50) and GPT-5.5 ($5/$30). Artificial Analysis and Anthropic's own pricing page both confirm those figures: the catalog was stale, not LMArena. See the fieldSourcePolicy correction in this file.
